desc: 停电应急供电主张，内构与接口微距取证，暗亮双场工业质感收口
leaf: 家用便携式开架汽油发电机
name: 家用便携纯铜静音发电机款

shots.intent: 用低机位压迫感与风暴天际线，一秒把买家带进停电应急情境，抢搜索点击。
shots.textZone: 顶部居中干净留白带：主标题位 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF at 44pt，其下一枚强调条 「{callout_1}」 in #2F6FE4 at 16pt

shots.intent: 在干净亮场把服务面正对镜头，用虚线强调弧承接核心利益点，稳住主图一秒法则。
shots.textZone: 上部干净留白带：主标题位 「{selling_point_2}」 in #2D2D2D at 36pt，下方一组三枚小圆点分隔符

shots.intent: 同一构图同一光位只改变有无电的状态，把停电损失具象化后再给出解法。
侧面实景加线缆与家电负载，让家庭买家把自己代入到夜里照常运转的画面。
把动力与发电芯从壳体里取出来拍，用结构本身替代口头承诺。
贴到日常插拔的接口上，用钣金纹与紧固件替代一切质量形容词。
俯拍白底主图看不到的顶面、机架与起动机构，用编号引线完成结构讲解。
shots.textZone: 左侧竖排三枚编号圆点条 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #2F6FE4 at 14pt，各接一根发丝引线指向对应部位

shots.intent: 用两条等长基线的条形差讲清续航优势，数值留给占位符避免编造。
shots.textZone: 每条右侧一枚标签位 「{callout_1}」 in #2F6FE4 at 16pt 与 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D at 16pt

shots.intent: 以紧固件、涂层断面与底脚三个可核验视窗建立信任，坚决不碰资质与认证。
shots.textZone: 三枚视窗下方各一条短标签位 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #2D2D2D at 14pt

shots.intent: 把三档理由收成编号条并给出唯一动作，详情页收口不留悬念。
shots.textZone: 每栏左侧一行短句位 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #FFFFFF at 18pt，底部一枚圆角按钮位 「{callout_4}」 in #2D2D2D at 20pt

style.backgroundSystem: two-part studio field alternating one matte #14130F section and one matte #E9ECEF section with a single soft horizon seam; no scenery, no gradient wash
style.iconSystem: minimal infographic only: numbered rounded chips in #2F6FE4, hairline leader lines, dashed accent arc, single hairline dividers
style.lightingSystem: raking side key from frame-left at 5600K that reads machined plate, coated tubing and cast housings, one slim rim light, firm contact shadow under the base, controlled speculars never blown out
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent premium industrial power-equipment ecommerce visual system across the whole set; fixed palette of base ground #14130F, base ground #E9ECEF, headline text #2D2D2D, one accent #2F6FE4 and one secondary material tone #B9BDC2; cool-neutral temperature throughout; one font family, modern geometric sans-serif, with heavy condensed weight for Chinese set in 「」; two-part background system alternating a matte #14130F section and a matte #E9ECEF section with one soft horizon seam and no scenery; raking side key light from frame-left at 5600K that renders machined plate, coated tubing and cast housings with visible grain, plus one slim rim light and a firm contact shadow that grounds the unit; minimal infographic language only, namely numbered rounded chips, thin leader lines, hairline dividers and one arc of dashes in #2F6FE4; the product is always the same single unit at stable scale with a level horizon and straight verticals kept straight; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched chip styles, no invented specification numbers, no certificates, no badges, no store marks.
noDrift: no certificates, badges or store marks
style.presentationRules: the same single unit at stable scale across every screen, level horizon, straight verticals kept straight, service face always legible, product never overlapped by props
style.surfaceSystem: coarse asphalt #24242A for the outdoor screens, poured concrete #6E7076 for the scene screen, matte seamless paper for studio screens
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, heavy condensed headline weight for Chinese set in 「」, headline 32-44pt, label 14-18pt, one family only
